Prime Minister congratulates Aditi Ashok, Pranavi Sharath Urs and Diksha Dagar on winning Silver in Women’s Team Golf at Asian Games

प्रविष्टि तिथि: 04 OCT 2026 9:53AM by PIB Delhi

The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has congratulated Aditi Ashok, Pranavi Sharath Urs and Diksha Dagar on winning the Silver medal in the Women’s Team Golf event at the Asian Games 2026.

The Prime Minister said that their success highlights their determination and passion for the sport.

Shri Modi wished Aditi Ashok, Pranavi Sharath Urs and Diksha Dagar continued success and expressed hope that they attain new heights of success in the times to come.

In a post on X, the Prime Minister’s Office said;

“Kudos to Aditi Ashok, Pranavi Sharath Urs and Diksha Dagar on winning the Silver Medal in the Women’s Team Golf event at the Asian Games 2026 yesterday. This success highlights their determination and passion for the sport. May they continue to attain new heights of success in the times to come: PM @narendramodi”

 

Kudos to Aditi Ashok, Pranavi Sharath Urs and Diksha Dagar on winning the Silver Medal in the Women’s Team Golf event at the Asian Games 2026 yesterday. This success highlights their determination and passion for the sport. May they continue to attain new heights of success in the times to come: PM @narendramodi

— PMO India (@PMOIndia) October 4, 2026
